triplets.head: Tencel Modal
triplets.tail: Recommended — hypoallergenic, antibacterial, wicks moisture 50% faster than cotton

triplets.head: Down (goose)
triplets.tail: Can trigger allergies — dust mites, feather proteins; may cause itchy skin, hives, or rashes

triplets.head: Wool
triplets.tail: Can irritate due to lanolin; some people have wool sensitivity or allergy

triplets.head: Natural latex (Dunlop/Talalay)
triplets.tail: True latex allergies exist but are rare; in mattresses/pillows, latex is encased with no direct skin contact

triplets.head: Polyester microfiber
triplets.tail: Traps heat and moisture, promotes bacterial growth, can cause friction-based micro-trauma to skin

triplets.head: Polyester microfiber
triplets.tail: Avoid for sensitive skin, eczema, and acne-prone skin

triplets.head: Nylon
triplets.tail: Traps heat and moisture, can cause microscopic skin trauma and inflammation

triplets.head: Memory foam (polyurethane)
triplets.tail: VOC off-gassing can cause skin rashes in sensitive individuals, especially when new; usually encased with no direct skin contact
